He kept it rather than throwing it away because someone had ideas about what to do with it later.

docs.title: Welkspring House
docs.text: After surviving the forest shortcut, Ravenlost entered the grounds of Welkspring House, hoping to find Osgood Escar and learn more about his connection to Glim Brightstone.

docs.title: The estate
docs.text:
The grounds were surprisingly well maintained, especially considering the creatures lurking in the surrounding forest.

  • A winding path led through immaculate gardens toward a large manor.
  • An enormous greenhouse stood beside the house, filled with greenery.
  • A topiary garden contained carefully trimmed animal figures.
  • The manor's front entrance had a raised porch, two staircases, and large French doors.

Ravenlost considered investigating the topiary animals but decided against it.

We had encountered enough dangerous plants for one day.

docs.title: A familiar automaton
docs.text:
When Ravenlost knocked on the manor's doors, a small automaton answered.

  • Approximately 3½ feet tall.
  • Humanoid upper body.
  • A large metal ball instead of legs.
  • Construction strongly reminiscent of Cedgewick, the automaton Ravenlost discovered in Glim Brightstone's laboratory.

The resemblance was immediately apparent to everyone.

Ravenlost mentioned both Glim and Cedgewick to the automaton, which offered to fetch its master.

Unfortunately, it couldn't climb stairs.

It repeatedly rolled into the bottom step until a voice called from upstairs.

Eventually, Osgood Escar came down to meet the party.

Important: We don't know who built this automaton or whether it has any direct connection to Cedgewick.

docs.title: Appearance
docs.text:
Osgood appeared to be in his late fifties.

  • Salt-and-pepper hair.
  • An eye patch.
  • Gardening clothes that appeared well worn and dirty.
  • A badly gnarled left leg requiring a cane.
  • A missing right hand, replaced by a bright silver mechanical hand.

The mechanical hand appeared capable of moving independently.

Something doesn't add up: Gilda's research established that Osgood purchased Welkspring House 73 years ago, yet he looks considerably younger than that.

Ravenlost noticed the discrepancy but did not question him about it.

docs.title: Our conversation with Osgood
docs.text:
Cadric began by telling Osgood that Lord Godfroy had sent Ravenlost.

Osgood immediately became guarded.

The conversation was difficult because Ravenlost couldn't offer a simple explanation of its relationship with Godfroy.

We told Osgood:

  • We had discovered one of Glim Brightstone's laboratories.
  • Godfroy was interested in Glim's inventions, particularly an augmented version of the batteries used to power his automatons.
  • We had encountered a Glim-related device beneath Candle Cross that could manipulate the Mists surrounding the town.
  • We suspected Godfroy intended to use Glim's technology to restore himself to life.
  • We were working on Godfroy's assignment but did not actually want to help him accomplish that goal.

Osgood was understandably skeptical.

docs.title: Glim Brightstone
docs.text:
Ravenlost also discussed Glim, whom Osgood had known many years earlier.

  • Osgood acknowledged his friendship with Glim.
  • His reaction suggested genuine affection.
  • Ravenlost explained that Glim had been missing for many years.
  • We shared what we knew about Glim's laboratory and his apparent connection to the devices Godfroy wanted.

We still don't know whether Osgood has any information about Glim's current whereabouts.

docs.title: Why Osgood should trust us?
docs.text:
Cadric and the others tried to explain that Ravenlost wasn't necessarily helping Godfroy simply because we had accepted his assignment.

We also pointed out that Godfroy already knew about Welkspring House.

If Ravenlost returned without useful information, he might send someone else—possibly someone less interested in protecting Osgood or Glim's research.

The party also explained something important about Cadric's equipment.

Godfroy's magical shortsword:

  • Godfroy had loaned Cadric a magical +1 shortsword.
  • Ravenlost discovered that Godfroy could use the weapon to scry on Cadric.
  • The party placed it inside the Bag of Holding to prevent that surveillance.
  • Cadric offered this as evidence that Ravenlost wasn't simply reporting everything back to Godfroy.

Eventually, Ravenlost made its position as clear as possible.

We are carrying out Godfroy's assignment, but we do not want to help him return to life and bring death and misery to others.

We just haven't figured out how to stop him.

docs.title: The invitation
docs.text:
After listening to Ravenlost's explanations, Osgood finally agreed to let us enter the manor.

He had one instruction:

“Come inside. But don't touch anything.”

Ravenlost entered Welkspring House.

docs.title: Open mysteries and questions for next session
docs.text:
These are the questions I'd carry forward into Session 9.

Mystery What we need to learn Osgood's age How can a human who purchased Welkspring House 73 years ago still appear to be in his fifties? Glim's whereabouts Does Osgood know where Glim went or why he disappeared? Glim and Osgood What was the nature of their relationship and their work together? The automaton Who built it, and why does it resemble Cedgewick? The greenhouse What is Osgood growing or researching there? The forest creatures What are they, and are they connected to Welkspring House? Godfroy's objective What exactly does he want from Glim's battery technology? The estate's protection What is the strange blue writing Godfroy mentioned, and how does it prevent ghosts from entering?

The final question is especially interesting because Ravenlost hasn't actually seen the blue writing yet. We only have Godfroy's description of it and that it might exist.

docs.title: Bia's notes - A little light gardening
Adventure at a glance
docs.text:
Ravenlost spent another day at Welkspring House, where Osgood Escar agreed to share what he knew about Glim Brightstone—but only if the party helped him destroy a dangerous Golthias blight growing in his enormous greenhouse. The corrupted birch was the source of a life-extending tincture Osgood had used for decades, though it had also begun transforming parts of his body into wood.

After defeating the blight and collecting samples, Ravenlost learned that Glim had visited Welkspring House 59 years earlier, destroyed much of his research, and dismantled an unusually large glimmer rune battery into three pieces. Osgood entrusted one of those pieces to the party. He also described Glim's machine for piercing the Mists and experiments involving the removal and possible transfer of souls.

Osgood marked a previously unmapped peninsula near Abbey Point on Ravenlost's map. An abbey and a silver-rich cave there might hold a vault Glim planned to create using his lunar rites.

Before leaving, Cadric insisted on harvesting hemlock from a grove downstream. The party encountered four dangerous frogs, including a giant flower-covered one that swallowed Bia. Ravenlost barely survived, but collected both ordinary white hemlock and a mysterious purple variety.

The party returned to Welkspring House, rested, gathered supplies, and arranged for Captain Jethro Fletcher to take them to Abbey Point. They arrived around 10 p.m., beneath a crumbling abbey with candlelight and moving shadows inside.

docs.title: Osgood's greenhouse and the Golthias blight
docs.text: Osgood asked Ravenlost to destroy a corrupted birch in his greenhouse in exchange for information about Glim. He did not want the greenhouse burned: it contained decades of botanical research and rare plants collected throughout Ravenloft.

docs.title: How the blight got there
docs.text:
• Years earlier, Osgood and fellow adventurers defeated a Golthias blight.
  • Osgood preserved a cutting and grafted it onto a birch tree in his greenhouse.
  • According to Osgood, Golthias blights are associated with vampires and dark energy. Barovian folklore describes terrible trees growing where a slain vampire has been staked, spawning blights from their roots and branches.
  • Osgood distilled the graft's sap into a life-extending tincture.
  • The graft had since grown out of control. Osgood suspected its roots were contaminating the greenhouse's water and spreading corruption into the surrounding woods.

Possible connection: The hostile plant creatures Ravenlost encountered on the forest shortcut might have originated from the greenhouse contamination. Osgood suspected this, but it was not confirmed.

docs.title: Osgood's age and transformations
docs.text:
Osgood explained the discrepancy that had bothered the party: he bought Welkspring House more than seventy years ago when he was approximately 50 years old. His tincture has prolonged his life.

The cost has been severe:

  • His missing hand has been replaced by a silver mechanical hand.
  • One leg has become twisted and branchlike, although it still ends in a foot.
  • His bandaged eye conceals an eye socket filled with wood.
  • The corruption spread through tissue near each injection site.
  • Glim helped Osgood manage some of the damage, but could not stop it completely.

Osgood temporarily stopped taking the tincture, but wants to resume it. He is not ready to die—and does not want to die in Mordent.

What we know: The tincture explains Osgood's unusual longevity and at least some of his physical transformations.

What we don't know: Whether the transformations can be reversed, or what would happen if Osgood resumed treatment.

docs.title: The greenhouse and the Death Garden
docs.text:
Osgood's greenhouse is an enormous steel-and-glass structure containing winding stone paths, waterways, a fountain, and dense vegetation. The air inside was hot and humid.

Osgood warned Ravenlost about a locked section called the Death Garden, which held his most dangerous specimens. He mentioned:

Plant or substance Effect or property Osgood described Hemlock Can render a victim unconscious Deadly nightshade Causes paralysis Giant hogweed sap Can severely damage exposed flesh Blue looper Leaves a persistent blue mark on skin

These are Osgood's descriptions, not effects the party independently tested.

docs.title: The topiary dog
docs.text:
Before entering the greenhouse, Ravenlost needed a key. Osgood whistled, and a decorative topiary dog jumped off its pedestal and ran to him like a friendly dog.

  • Osgood opened a panel in the dog's chest, revealing machinery.
  • He retrieved the greenhouse key from inside.
  • The dog was an automaton disguised as a topiary, not an ordinary plant creature.
  • Cadric reminded Jain that he had warned her not to touch the plants.

The topiary dog is another example of the unusual technology at Welkspring House. We do not know who built it.

docs.title: The fight with the corrupted birch
docs.text: The birch was enormous, with twisted branches, unnatural purple growths, and roots extending beneath the paths. Its vines and roots attacked the party, restrained combatants, and dragged them toward its trunk. The tree itself moved through the greenhouse.

docs.title: What happened
docs.text:
• Bia raged, charged the blight, and repeatedly attacked it with her axe.
  • Jain used Jump to leap into the tree. Her first strike bounced off its bark and the blight threw her away. She jumped back in a second time.
  • One of the blight's vines injured Jain and drained her strength with necrotic energy.
  • Cadric used Cloud of Daggers to cut through the plant growth like a magical lawnmower.
  • Elisandra attacked with radiant magic, which appeared particularly effective.
  • Jain removed a poisonous vine from her leg, then picked the lock on the Death Garden. She narrowly avoided a concealed needle trap.
  • Badly hurt, Jain rested on a chaise lounge in the Death Garden while the others continued fighting.
  • Elisandra delivered the final blow with a powerful burst of radiant energy.

docs.title: Samples and contamination
docs.text:
After the fight, Ravenlost inspected the greenhouse's waterways.

  • The water looked clear at first.
  • Roots extending into the pond were shedding tiny black and purple particles.
  • Water flowed from the greenhouse through its drainage system, potentially carrying contamination into the forest.
  • The roots were beginning to wither after the blight died.
  • Ravenlost collected a large branch specimen and water samples for Osgood.

Unanswered question: How far did the contaminated runoff spread, and what creatures or plants were affected?

docs.title: Glim Brightstone — the revelations
docs.text: Osgood honored his agreement after receiving the blight specimen.

docs.title: Glim's final visit to Welkspring House
docs.text:
Osgood last saw Glim working at Welkspring House 59 years ago.

  • Glim arrived distressed, carrying a satchel full of glimmer rune cells.
  • He destroyed much of his research, including notes and schematics.
  • He apologized to Osgood for bringing danger to the house.
  • Before leaving, he dismantled an unusually large battery into three pieces.
  • He gave one fragment to Osgood for safekeeping.

We do not know who has the other two fragments, or why Glim felt he had to destroy his work.

docs.title: The helix battery fragment
docs.text:
Osgood had been wearing the fragment on a leather cord beneath his clothes.

Property Description Shape Helix Length Approximately 5 inches Weight and temperature Unexpectedly heavy and cold to the touch Markings Intricate blue runes, with three lines on each face Comparison Roughly three times as many runes as the ordinary batteries Ravenlost has seen Identify result No conventional spell identified in its construction; suggested a connection to contacting other planes Custody Osgood loaned the fragment to Ravenlost

Osgood provided a pouch, and Ravenlost put the helix inside it before placing the pouch in Elisandra's Bag of Holding. The party wanted to reduce the risk of Godfroy spying on the device.

Important: The fragment is on loan. Osgood asked Ravenlost to return it someday.

docs.title: The machine to pierce the Mists
docs.text:
Osgood described Glim's larger invention:

  • A horizontal barrel surrounded by glass tubes.
  • A central core and two rods projecting forward.
  • A rear control panel with buttons, switches, and wooden levers.
  • The rods could be aimed independently.
  • The enormous battery was designed to power the machine.

Osgood witnessed a test that produced a blinding light and opened a passage approximately 10 feet across, extending into the Mists farther than he could see.

Glim hoped the technology might eventually remove the barriers between Ravenloft's domains.

docs.title: Experiments involving souls
docs.text:
Osgood also revealed that Glim had:

  • Successfully removed souls from animals during experiments.
  • Considered whether a soul could be transferred into another body.

This raises an alarming possibility because Lord Godfroy is a ghost confined to Griffin Hill.

Our theory: Godfroy may want Glim's machine or battery technology to restore himself to a living body.

Not confirmed: We have no proof that Glim successfully transferred a soul into another body, or that Godfroy's specific plan is resurrection.

docs.title: Ideas for keeping the technology from Godfroy
docs.text:
Ravenlost discussed possible countermeasures, including:

  • Sabotaging Glim's machine.
  • Replacing a battery component with something dangerous.
  • Using Nondetection or Nystul's Magic Aura to conceal their actions.

Status: These were ideas, not an agreed plan. Ravenlost has not yet decided what to do.

docs.title: The missing peninsula and Glim's possible vault
docs.text:
Osgood identified a wooded peninsula north of Abbey Point that is missing from ordinary maps. He had visited the area with Glim many years earlier.

  • An abbey stands on the peninsula.
  • Osgood recalled monks whose behavior unsettled him.
  • A nearby cave contains substantial silver deposits.
  • Glim intended to use the cave as a vault.
  • He planned to use what he called his lunar rites to imbue the silver.
  • Osgood marked the location on Ravenlost's map.

What we don't know: Whether Glim completed the vault, what the lunar rites accomplish, or what—if anything—is still in the cave.

docs.title: Osgood's assistance
docs.text:
Before Ravenlost left, Osgood offered:

  • Healing potions and poison supplies.
  • A letter introducing the party to Mikhail at the hospital for a later trip to Falkovnia.
  • Four additional vials the next morning, whose contents would be explained later.

He asked the party to return his helix fragment and bring him news of Glim. Ravenlost promised to try.

docs.title: The hemlock grove
docs.text:
Cadric wanted to gather hemlock before leaving Echo Island. Ravenlost followed the greenhouse's runoff downhill toward the coast.

  • It was dark by the time the party reached the grove.
  • Cadric and Elisandra used their custom EC lights; Bia and Jain relied on darkvision.
  • The grove was marshy and contained both white and unusual purple hemlock flowers.
  • Cadric initially wanted ordinary white hemlock for contact poison.
  • Jain noticed eyes watching from the vegetation; the others noticed them too.
  • The party encountered a giant king frog and smaller frogs.

The giant frog had white flowers growing on its head and back. Flowers also lined its mouth and released pollen when it opened its jaws.

docs.title: The frog battle
docs.text:
The chapter describes four frogs fought in total, including the giant king frog.

  • Bia charged the king frog and struck it with her axe before raging.
  • The frog's tongue grappled Bia and dragged her toward its mouth. She resisted the initial poison, but it swallowed her whole.
  • Bia kept attacking from inside and managed to drive her axe through the creature.
  • The smaller frogs also used grappling tongues and poisonous bites.
  • Cadric cast Cloud of Daggers, which killed the king frog.
  • Bia escaped its stomach—directly into Cadric's Cloud of Daggers, taking damage from the same spell that freed her.
  • Another frog swallowed Elisandra.
  • Elisandra cast Shatter from inside, causing the frog to explode.
  • The blast threw Elisandra clear, but she landed unconscious.
  • Jain used Jump to reach Elisandra and tried to stabilize her. Healing magic eventually revived her.
  • Another frog bit Bia hard enough to knock her unconscious, but her orcish Relentless Endurance kept her standing at 1 HP.
  • Ravenlost defeated the remaining frogs.

Combat reminder for Bia: Relentless Endurance prevented her from dropping to 0 HP once during the frog battle. This is a record of what happened in Session 9, not a statement about its availability in a future encounter.

docs.title: What we harvested
docs.text:
Collector Item Amount or status Cadric Ordinary white hemlock 12 full doses Cadric Unusual purple hemlock 3 doses, intended for Osgood to study Bia Purple hemlock flower 1 flower, collected quietly without telling the others

Unknown: Whether the purple hemlock has different effects from ordinary hemlock, or whether its color is related to the blight's contamination.

docs.title: Back at Welkspring House
docs.text:
Ravenlost returned to the estate injured and exhausted. The party noticed blue runes glowing along the gates, fences, and greenhouse framework in the moonlight.

This is the first time the party actually saw the blue writing associated with the estate's protection. We have not independently tested whether it prevents ghosts from entering, as Godfroy had claimed.

docs.title: Gustav's attempts to help
docs.text:
Osgood's automaton Gustav was in the sitting room.

  • Jain asked Gustav to bring sugar.
  • Gustav returned with an enormous 25-pound barrel—apparently all the sugar Osgood owned.
  • Jain then asked for water and lemons, but Gustav needed a description of a lemon.
  • The party joked that he might return with brownies painted yellow.

docs.title: Further research for Osgood
docs.text:
• Cadric showed Osgood the purple hemlock.
  • Osgood agreed to study it and the blight specimen.
  • The party asked whether the blight's ability to turn living tissue into wood could be separated or intensified.
  • Osgood was alarmed by the party's interest in stronger poisons but agreed to investigate.

docs.title: Glim and Osgood's relationship
docs.text:
Osgood acknowledged that Glim had been more than a friend.

This confirms that their relationship was more personal than Ravenlost had previously been able to establish, though the chapter does not provide further details.

Ravenlost took a long rest at the house, despite the lack of proper guest accommodations.

docs.title: Farewell to Osgood and Gustav
docs.text:
The following morning:

  • Osgood gave the party four additional vials; their contents were not yet explained.
  • He agreed to continue examining the samples.
  • He again requested news of Glim and the eventual return of his battery fragment.
  • Ravenlost said goodbye to Gustav.
  • Osgood believed the forest would be safer with the greenhouse blight destroyed.
  • He asked the party to tell Ava that she could return to Welkspring House.

docs.title: Ava's response
docs.text:
Ravenlost found Ava near her home, cutting trees and making wooden sculptures.

  • She was pleased that the woods were safer.
  • She was not eager to return to work.
  • Osgood had paid her one year's wages to stay away from the estate, and she intended to enjoy the time off.

docs.title: Shauncey and Cadric's new song
docs.text:
Back at the sailors' lodging, Ravenlost found Shauncey hung over and collected cured fish for the next voyage.

Cadric performed another installment of his song about Ravenlost. This verse described his meeting with Jain, the dangerous Lupine he encountered in the Mists, and how he offered her a meal rather than fighting her.

The performance received mixed reviews but woke a passed-out Captain Jethro Fletcher. Cadric still planned to write a verse about Elisandra.

docs.title: Negotiating with Captain Fletcher
docs.text:
Ravenlost had previously arranged passage aboard The Fletcher in exchange for six cases of liquor, delivered in installments.

The party now asked Jethro to continue on to Abbey Point.

  • Cadric claimed that the abbey housed master brewers.
  • Ravenlost promised Jethro a barrel of liquor.
  • Jethro agreed to extend the voyage but said Abbey Point would be his final destination.
  • The party would need him to wait while they obtained the promised barrel.

Outstanding obligation: Ravenlost owes Jethro the promised barrel.

docs.title: Arrival
docs.text:
The voyage north took approximately 14 hours and passed without incident.

  • Towering walls of the Mists rose on either side of the peninsula.
  • A narrow opening led toward Abbey Point.
  • Ravenlost arrived at approximately 10 p.m.
  • A crumbling abbey stood high above the shoreline.
  • Candlelight showed in its windows, and shadows moved inside.
  • A dock stood below, with a fishing boat tied alongside and several overturned canoes nearby.
  • Jethro brought The Fletcher alongside the dock.

Current location: Abbey Point. Ravenlost has not yet investigated the abbey or the possible vault.

docs.title: Important items and commitments
docs.text: Item or commitment Status at the end of Session 9 Glim's helix battery fragment Loaned by Osgood; in a pouch inside Elisandra's Bag of Holding Marked map Osgood marked the possible silver-vault location near Abbey Point Blight branch specimen and water samples Collected for Osgood's research White hemlock Cadric harvested 12 full doses Purple hemlock Cadric harvested 3 doses for study; Bia secretly kept 1 flower Healing potions and poison supplies Offered by Osgood; individual quantities not specified in the chapter Four additional vials Given by Osgood; contents to be explained later Letter for Mikhail Offered by Osgood for a future journey to the hospital in Falkovnia Cured fish Collected at Shauncey's lodging for the voyage Promised barrel of liquor Owed to Jethro; not yet obtained News of Glim Ravenlost promised to bring Osgood any information they learn Return of battery fragment Ravenlost promised to return Osgood's loaned fragment someday

docs.title: Open mysteries and questions for next session
docs.text:
Mystery What we need to learn Abbey Point Who lives in the abbey, and why did Osgood find its monks unsettling? Glim's possible vault Did Glim complete the silver vault, and what might be inside? Lunar rites What did Glim mean by lunar rites, and how was he imbuing silver? The other battery fragments Where are the remaining two pieces of Glim's enormous battery? Glim's disappearance Why was Glim distressed 59 years ago, and what danger made him destroy his research? The soul experiments Did Glim ever succeed in transferring a soul into another body? Godfroy's intentions Is he seeking a way to return to life, or does he have another use for the machine? Osgood's condition Can the tincture's transformations be halted or reversed? Forest contamination Did the greenhouse runoff create or alter the creatures in the woods and the hemlock grove? Purple hemlock What makes it purple, and does it have different properties? Osgood's research What will his study of the blight and hemlock specimens reveal? Four mystery vials What do the additional vials Osgood gave the party contain? Blue runes Do the glowing markings actually prevent ghosts from entering Welkspring House? Jethro's payment How will Ravenlost obtain the barrel of liquor promised to the captain?

Next: Investigate the abbey at Abbey Point, then find out whether Glim's silver vault exists—and whether it holds answers Ravenlost can keep out of Godfroy's hands.

docs.title: Bia's notes - The secrets of the silver mine
Adventure at a glance
docs.text:
Ravenlost arrived at Abbey Point and investigated the abandoned silver mine once owned by Glim Brightstone. Along the way, the party encountered silent monks, giant spiders, a soldier from Falkovnia, a ghost, undead miners, and an automaton that nearly interrupted their long rest permanently.

The party discovered that Falkovnia was being overrun by undead, and Bia learned that a military commander named Korath was defending a stronghold there. She had heard that name twice before, both times under disturbing circumstances.

Inside Glim's vault, Ravenlost found evidence that someone had removed a mysterious device. They also recovered a recording in which Glim revealed that he intended to entrust his final piece to Mikhail Hatzimvas, a physician in Falkovnia.

The recording ended with a haunting whistle, a howl, and a warning about being taken to an old inn in Kartikoz.

Ravenlost finished the session resting inside the vault.

Current location: Glim Brightstone's vault, beneath the abandoned silver mine near Abbey Point.

Party level: 5 following the session's level-up.

docs.title: Abbey Point and its silent monks
The abbey
docs.text:
• Captain Jethro Fletcher remained aboard The Fletcher while Gobbo accompanied Ravenlost.
  • The abbey housed 17 monks devoted to Ezra, the Lady of the Mists.
  • The monks had taken vows of silence and communicated through sign language.
  • Bia was able to communicate with them because she knew sign language.
  • Davos welcomed the party and provided food, blankets, and accommodations.
  • The abbey had no alcohol, despite Ravenlost's promise to bring Fletcher a barrel of ale.

docs.title: Abbot Katun's information
docs.text:
Abbot Katun provided several important details:

  • Glim Brightstone owned the silver mine.
  • Polk was the mine's foreman.
  • Silver was transported from the mine toward the coast and Echo Island.
  • Glim studied writings and symbols associated with Ezra.
  • Glim departed toward the mine with a covered wagon containing something concealed.
  • Five travelers from Mordenshire visited the abbey approximately seven or eight months earlier, then headed toward the mine.
  • None of those five travelers returned.

docs.title: Other observations
docs.text:
• Giant spiders had occupied the nearby forest for approximately two years.
  • Creatures sometimes emerged from the surrounding Mists.
  • Weathered runes on the abbey's stonework appeared connected to symbols associated with Glim.
  • The journey from the abbey to the mine would take approximately a day and a half.

Unanswered: Why was Glim studying Ezra's symbols, and what was hidden in his wagon?

docs.title: The elk and giant spider
docs.text:
Ravenlost encountered a large elk trapped in an enormous web and freed it.

Shortly afterward, a spider approximately the size of a horse approached.

  • Gobbo hid inside a hollow log and became stuck.
  • Rather than leave him behind, Bia picked up the entire log and carried it away from danger.
  • Bia freed Gobbo once they reached safety.
  • The spider followed and attacked.
  • Jain inflicted significant damage, and Bia helped finish it.

docs.title: Collected materials
docs.text:
Item Quantity Storage Giant spider legs 8 Elisandra's bag of holding Spider goo 1 vial Elisandra's bag of holding

Jain collected the legs, and Cadric collected the goo.

docs.title: The web-covered sacks
docs.text:
Farther along the trail, Ravenlost encountered numerous silk-wrapped bundles hanging from trees and scattered along the ground.

The party burned through the webbing with torches.

Among the contents were:

  • A surviving Falkovnian soldier, Ala'kir
  • Animal remains, including an elk
  • A partially digested hobgoblin
  • Humanoid and canine-humanoid bones
  • A swarm of venomous baby spiders
  • An undead ogre

The baby spiders poisoned and paralyzed Elisandra before being destroyed.

The undead ogre attacked after its sack was opened. Ravenlost fought it with help from Ala'kir and Gobbo.

Gobbo delivered the killing blow by decapitating the ogre.

docs.title: Ala'kir and the invasion of Falkovnia
Who is Ala'kir?
docs.text:
• A soldier from Falkovnia
  • Wore leather armor bearing a large bird's talon insignia
  • Was found alive inside a spider's silk cocoon
  • Had a serious, festering shoulder wound
  • Received medical attention from Elisandra

Ala'kir recognized Bia as an orc and suspected she might be from Falkovnia.

docs.title: What happened in Falkovnia?
docs.text:
Ala'kir reported that massive undead hordes had begun attacking Falkovnia approximately six weeks earlier.

  • The military was struggling to contain the invasion.
  • Fort Watten, along the southern border, had been breached.
  • Undead were advancing from multiple directions.
  • Settlements were threatened, and survivors were seeking fortified positions.
  • Ala'kir's regiment had been reduced to ten soldiers by the time they entered the Mists.
  • Only three remained when they emerged in Mordent.

docs.title: Why this matters to Bia
docs.text:
Bia left Falkovnia approximately six weeks earlier, shortly before the invasion began.

Her adoptive father, Tobin Underfoot, and adoptive sister, Mira, are still there.

Their current whereabouts and safety are unknown.

Bia needs to determine:

  • Whether their village has been attacked
  • Whether Tobin and Mira survived
  • Whether they escaped to a fortified settlement
  • Whether anyone in Falkovnia can provide news of them

Bia's priority: Finish the current mission and return to Falkovnia as soon as possible, with or without the rest of Ravenlost if necessary.

docs.title: Commander Korath — a name from Bia's past
docs.text:
Ala'kir recommended seeking shelter at the stronghold in Lekar, defended by Commander Korath.

Bia immediately recognized the name.

docs.title: First occurrence — the destruction of Bia's childhood village
docs.text:
When Bia was six years old:

  • Her orc village in Falkovnia was attacked.
  • Her mother, Anthea, hid her in a cellar with a wooden doll.
  • Bia heard fighting and screaming.
  • She heard someone or something say the name Korath.
  • Bia remained hidden for two days.
  • When she emerged, her father, Voros, was dead.
  • Her mother was missing.
  • The village had been destroyed.

Bia later found another village within Falkovnia and was adopted by Tobin Underfoot, who raised her alongside Mira.

docs.title: Second occurrence — the farm attack
docs.text:
Years later, Bia defended a village during an attack on a farm.

  • Bia saved the village.
  • Several children were frightened by what they witnessed.
  • Bia could not remember the fight itself.
  • She could infer what had happened from the carnage afterward.
  • She did remember hearing the name Korath.

docs.title: Third occurrence — Ala'kir's account
docs.text:
Ala'kir identified Korath as a military commander defending survivors in Falkovnia.

This is the third time Bia has encountered the name.

docs.title: Unanswered questions
docs.text:
• Are all three references to the same Korath?
  • Was Korath involved in the attack on Bia's childhood village?
  • Why did the name recur during the farm attack?
  • Why can't Bia remember that fight?
  • Is Commander Korath truly protecting Falkovnia's survivors?
  • Could Korath know anything about Anthea's disappearance?

Important: Bia has no proof that Commander Korath is connected to either earlier incident.

docs.title: Parting ways with Ala'kir and Gobbo
docs.text:
Ravenlost suggested that Ala'kir accompany them, but ultimately directed him toward the safety of Abbey Point.

Gobbo also decided to return.

docs.title: Payment
docs.text:
The party had promised Captain Fletcher a barrel of ale, but the abbey had none.

Bia gave Gobbo 25 gold pieces:

Intended recipient Amount Gobbo 10 gp Captain Jethro Fletcher 15 gp Total 25 gp

Bia warned Gobbo that she would kill him if she later discovered he had failed to deliver Fletcher's share.

Unconfirmed: Whether Fletcher actually received the 15 gp.

Ala'kir and Gobbo departed together toward Abbey Point.

docs.title: Outside the mine
docs.text:
• The entrance had partially collapsed.
  • Bia cleared rubble to reopen the passage.
  • Old tents, crates, and abandoned supplies remained outside.
  • The party found wire, detonation cord, and other mining materials.
  • Tracks indicated that five humanoid travelers had approached the mine.

Possible connection: These may have been the five travelers from Mordenshire, but their identities were not confirmed.

docs.title: Inside the mine
docs.text:
The upper tunnels contained:

  • Old minecart rails
  • Silver deposits
  • Eight apparent miner skeletons
  • Canine-humanoid remains
  • A canine-humanoid skeleton with a pickaxe lodged in its skull
  • Barricades and evidence of violent fighting
  • Abandoned supplies, including rope, kerosene lanterns, and detonation cord

Some crates were marked PMC.

Useful supplies were collected and placed in Elisandra's bag of holding.

docs.title: Klem, the ghost of the mine
docs.text:
Ravenlost encountered a ghost named Klem.

He had been trapped in the mine for 58 years, 7 months, and 3 days.

docs.title: Klem's account
docs.text:
• Canine creatures attacked the mine and killed many workers.
  • Polk led miners toward the lower levels during the attack.
  • Glim brought chests and a large covered object into the mine.
  • Glim left after the vault was completed.
  • A later group entered the mine searching for valuables.
  • Only one member of that group escaped, carrying a bag.
  • Giant spiders arrived approximately two years ago.
  • Humanoid spider creatures also inhabit the mine.

docs.title: Klem's request
docs.text:
Klem wants Ravenlost to recover his remains and bury them outside the mine.

He hopes a proper burial might free him.

Status: Not completed.

docs.title: Concerns
docs.text:
Ravenlost wondered whether freeing Klem would expose him to Lord Godfroy's control over spirits in Mordent.

The party has not determined whether Klem would be safe after burial.

docs.title: The runaway minecart and descent
docs.text:
A trapped minecart suddenly raced down the tracks toward Ravenlost.

  • The cart struck Jain.
  • Bia stepped into its path.
  • Bia stopped the cart through sheer strength, taking damage in the process.
  • The party continued toward the lower levels.

The elevator was broken, with the platform approximately 85 feet below.

Ravenlost descended using ropes.

Elisandra fell during the descent and required healing.

The party eventually regrouped in the lower mine.

docs.title: Polk and the battle for the vault
Polk
docs.text:
Polk was Glim Brightstone's former mine foreman.

He remained in the lower mine as an undead guardian, apparently still determined to protect Glim's property.

docs.title: The battle
docs.text:
• Polk attacked Ravenlost with dynamite.
  • Skeletons rose to defend the vault.
  • Cadric used Dissonant Whispers and Cloud of Daggers.
  • The party fought among barricades, debris, and explosive barrels.
  • Jain was knocked unconscious.
  • Elisandra was also knocked unconscious.
  • Bia carried the unconscious Jain out of danger.
  • Healing magic and potions helped keep the party alive.
  • Ravenlost defeated Polk.
  • The remaining skeletons turned to ash.

Outcome: Ravenlost survived and gained access to Glim's vault.

docs.title: What Ravenlost discovered
docs.text:
The vault contained:

  • Storage chests
  • Several damaged automatons
  • A floating dais
  • Ordinary Glim batteries
  • Treasure and useful supplies

The floating dais appeared to have once supported a large device.

Someone had removed it.

Ravenlost did not find the matching three-pronged key or unusually large battery they had hoped to locate.

Possible connection: The missing device may have been taken by the survivor Klem saw escaping with a bag. This is unconfirmed.

docs.title: The automaton
docs.text:
While Ravenlost attempted a long rest, Jain took the first watch.

Approximately two hours later, an automaton activated and seized her leg.

It warned the party to leave under threat of death.

Elisandra showed it the pendant received from Osgood.

The automaton requested a password.

Bia answered:

"Osgood."

The password was accepted, and the automaton released Jain.

It then played Glim's recorded message.

docs.title: Glim's final recording
docs.text: The automaton played what Glim described as his final log.

docs.title: Glim's words
docs.text:
"This will be my last log. I'm going to give Hatzimvas my last piece, and then I'm going into the mists where those fiends can't find me."

The recording continued with a low, taunting whistle.

Glim exclaimed:

"God damn it!"

A wolf-like howl followed.

Glim then said:

"They found me again. If they get me, he will take me to Kartikoz at the old inn."

The recording captured a struggle, another howl, and then ended.

docs.title: What Ravenlost learned
docs.text:
Mikhail Hatzimvas

  • A physician operating a hospital in Falkovnia
  • Treats people afflicted by the undead plague
  • Previously mentioned during the party's visit to Griffin Hill
  • Osgood provided a letter of introduction to him
  • Glim intended to give him his final piece

Kartikoz and the old inn

  • Glim named Kartikoz as the location where he expected to be taken if captured.
  • He referred to an old inn.
  • The identity of the person Glim called "he" is unknown.

The haunting whistle

  • A low, taunting melody could be heard in the background.
  • Cadric listened carefully and wrote down the notes.
  • The melody may help identify Glim's pursuer.

The howl

  • The sound resembled a wolf-like howl.
  • Jain could not identify it as an ordinary wolf.
  • Its source remains unknown.

docs.title: Important distinctions
docs.text:
• Glim intended to give his final piece to Mikhail; Ravenlost has not verified that the transfer occurred.
  • The recording does not establish who pursued Glim.
  • The party does not know whether Glim survived the encounter.
  • The old inn's exact identity and location remain unresolved.

docs.title: Treasure recovered from the vault
docs.text:
Item Quantity Notes Gold 400 gp Divided into four shares of 100 gp Emeralds 2 Value not established Greater healing potions 2 Party supplies Unidentified potion 1 Appeared to contain suspended gas Revivify kit 1 Contains one remaining diamond Black powder barrels 3 Recovered from the mine Dynamite 2 sticks Remaining after the battle

The collected items were placed in Elisandra's bag of holding. The gold was divided into individual shares.

docs.title: Other collected supplies
docs.text:
• Eight giant spider legs
  • One vial of spider goo
  • Mining supplies, including detonation cord
  • Four boxed kerosene lanterns
  • Rope and other useful materials

docs.title: Bia's money
docs.text:
Transaction Gold Starting balance 1,501 gp Payment to Gobbo −25 gp Share of vault treasure +100 gp Ending balance 1,576 gp

Bia's ending currency: 1,576 gp, 8 sp, 6 cp.

This assumes no other unrecorded spending during Session 10.

docs.title: Important items and commitments
docs.text: Item or commitment Status Osgood's helix battery fragment On loan; stored in Elisandra's bag of holding Osgood's pendant Used to authenticate the party to Glim's automaton Letter for Mikhail Hatzimvas Intended for use at the hospital in Falkovnia Cadric's transcription of the whistle Recorded for future investigation Missing vault device Not recovered Klem's remains Not yet recovered or buried Gobbo's payment to Fletcher 15 gp entrusted to Gobbo; delivery unconfirmed News of Glim for Osgood New information discovered; not yet delivered Return of Osgood's fragment Still outstanding

docs.title: Open mysteries and questions for next session
docs.text:
Mystery What we need to learn Tobin and Mira Are Bia's adoptive father and sister safe in Falkovnia? Commander Korath Is he connected to the destruction of Bia's village or the later farm attack? Bia's missing memories What happened during the farm battle, and why can't Bia remember it? Falkovnia invasion How far have the undead advanced, and which settlements remain secure? Mikhail Hatzimvas Did Glim successfully entrust his final piece to the physician? Glim's pursuers Who are the fiends hunting Glim, and who is the "he" mentioned in his recording? Kartikoz Where is the old inn, and what happened to Glim there? Haunting whistle Can Cadric's recorded melody help identify the pursuer? Missing vault device Who removed the object from the floating dais, and where is it now? Five travelers What happened to the missing visitors from Mordenshire? Klem's remains Can Ravenlost recover and bury them safely? Spider creatures What are the humanoid spiders, and do they remain in the mine? Godfroy's intentions What does Lord Godfroy intend to do with Glim's technology? Other battery fragments Where are the remaining pieces of Glim's unusual battery? Osgood's research What has he learned about the blight, purple hemlock, and other collected specimens? Captain Fletcher Did Gobbo deliver the promised 15 gp?

Next: Ravenlost must decide how to leave the mine and whether to address Klem's unfinished business before departing. Falkovnia is becoming increasingly urgent—not only because of Mikhail and Glim's missing piece, but because Bia needs to find her family and learn the truth about Korath.

docs.title: Adventure at a glance
docs.text:
Ravenlost escaped Glim Brightstone's silver mine, fought the creatures guarding Klem's remains, and fulfilled its promise to carry the ghost miner's bones outside. Klem vanished afterward, although whether he found peace is unknown.

The party then entered the Mists, found an eleven-year-old refugee named Matteo, and learned more about the undead invasion of Falkovnia. Along the way they crossed a ravine above a monstrous mass of bodies, heard a battle involving a wagon but chose not to investigate, and encountered five burned deserters impaled on stakes.

Near the Stone Spine Mountains, Ravenlost met Zlava, an elderly woman imprisoned in a watchtower for stealing bread. She shared information about the undead hordes and warned the party not to trust Commander Korath. After resting and reaching level 5, Ravenlost freed Zlava and set out toward Delmunster with Matteo.

Current location: Near the Stone Spine Mountains in Falkovnia, heading toward Delmunster through the Forest of Strangers.

Party level: 5.

Traveling companion: Matteo. Zlava departed separately into the Mists.

docs.title: The climb
docs.text:
• Ravenlost began inside Glim's vault.
  • With the elevator broken, the party climbed approximately 65 feet to the upper mine using rope.
  • Cadric spent part of the ascent partially inside Elisandra's bag of holding.
  • Ravenlost still intended to recover Klem's remains before leaving.

docs.title: The web-covered chamber
docs.text:
The chamber was thickly coated in webs, almost like the inside of a cocoon. The strands looked silvery and wet in the light.

  • Klem had been persuaded to scout ahead. A giant spider tried to attack him, but the attack passed through his ghostly form, and he retreated.
  • Elisandra threw illuminated stones into the chamber.
  • Cadric investigated and saw a spider-like humanoid examining the light.
  • Bia attempted to sneak in but was unsuccessful.
  • Bia attempted to communicate with one of the smaller creatures using Beast Sense; the attempt failed because it was not an animal.
  • Jain tried to distract the creatures with a performance, without success.
  • Jain used her Necklace of Disguise to resemble one of the spider-like humanoids.

docs.title: The battle
docs.text:
Creature Confirmed outcome Giant spider 1 Killed Giant spider 2 Killed Spider-like humanoid 1 Badly injured; escaped back through the tunnel Spider-like humanoid 2 Badly injured; climbed out through the Honda-sized opening overhead
  • Jain attempted to shove a spider into a web; it caught itself on a strand.
  • Jain used a howl that hindered enemies.
  • Elisandra cast a fire Chromatic Orb.
  • Ravenlost let the two injured humanoids flee instead of pursuing them.

Suspected, not confirmed: The creature that fled through the tunnel may have escaped into the woods. Ravenlost did not encounter it again.

Unanswered: What were the spider-like humanoids? Could either return?

docs.title: Klem, the ghost of the mine
Recovering his remains
docs.text:
Bia moved the boulders covering Klem's crushed remains. Much of the skeleton was reduced to dust, although his legs were still recognizable.

Bia told Cadric to fetch Klem and let him know the chamber was safe.

The party also recovered a silver dowsing rod near the remains. Klem said he had used it to find minerals, chiefly silver and sometimes salt.

docs.title: Keeping the promise
docs.text:
• The dowsing rod went into Elisandra's bag of holding.
  • Ravenlost placed Klem's remains in a minecart and brought them outside.
  • Klem said, “That should work.”
  • He vanished.

Confirmed: Ravenlost recovered Klem's remains and brought them outside the mine.

Unanswered: Did Klem's disappearance mean he was finally freed? The party did not confirm his fate.

docs.title: Journey into the Mists
docs.text:
Ravenlost tied themselves together with rope to avoid becoming separated.

  • Visibility was approximately 20 feet.
  • The temperature dropped by roughly 10°F.
  • The surroundings shifted into a sparse, windswept landscape.
  • After approximately eight hours, Jain spotted a dilapidated barn.

docs.title: The abandoned barn
docs.text:
An Augury warned against staying at the barn, but the party investigated.

They found a dead cow, apparently six to eight weeks old, with bite marks. Small footprints and movement in the hayloft suggested someone was there.

docs.title: Finding Matteo
docs.text:
The person hiding in the hayloft was Matteo, an eleven-year-old blond boy from Aerie, in southern Falkovnia. Ravenlost gave him food and water and agreed to bring him along.

Detail What Matteo reported Age 11 Hometown Aerie, southern Falkovnia Time hiding Approximately nine days Parents Missing following an undead attack Sisters Susie and Haley, seven-year-old twins; also missing Destination Traveling with Ravenlost; hoping to find safety

Unanswered: What happened to Matteo's parents and sisters? His account establishes that they were separated, not that they died.

docs.title: The invasion
docs.text: Matteo described zombies, undead ogres, undead birds, and other horrors. Refugees were being directed toward Lekar, particularly the Red Gate. Ravenlost also encountered undead birds that fled into the Mists.

docs.title: Commander Korath and the Talons
docs.text:
Matteo described Commander Korath, a woman, as a harsh ruler who governs with an iron fist.

  • The Talons enforce military authority.
  • Conscription can begin at fourteen, though farmers may sometimes be exempt.
  • Desertion can carry severe punishment.

Reported, not independently verified: Matteo's descriptions of Korath's government and the military's rules.

docs.title: Why this matters to Bia
docs.text:
Bia left Falkovnia approximately six weeks earlier, shortly before the invasion began. Her adoptive father, Tobin Underfoot, and adoptive sister, Mira, were still there when she left.

Matteo suggested survivors might have fled toward Lekar.

Possible lead: Tobin and Mira may have sought refuge in Lekar.

Not known: Whether they survived or reached the city.

docs.title: The ravine and the moving mass of bodies
docs.text: Ravenlost reached a ravine approximately 30 feet wide. Far below, an enormous mass of compressed bodies moved through the valley; individual bodies sometimes broke away and fell.

docs.title: Crossing the ravine
docs.text:
• Elisandra, Cadric, and Matteo climbed into the bag of holding.
  • Bia carried the bag.
  • Jain cast Jump on Bia.
  • Bia and Jain jumped across in sync, and everyone crossed safely.

Matteo said the creature resembled something he had seen near his family's farm.

Unanswered: What was the creature, and what caused or directed it?

docs.title: The wagon on the hill
docs.text:
After crossing the ravine, Ravenlost heard sounds of fighting from a hillside. Someone shouted:

“Circle up and protect the wagon!”

The party considered investigating, including the possibility of finding useful items. But everyone was exhausted, the Mists remained dangerous, and another fight was not appealing.

Decision: Ravenlost kept walking. They did not investigate the wagon, join the fight, or collect any loot—a surprisingly restrained choice for the party.

Unanswered: Who was fighting, what was in the wagon, and what happened afterward?

docs.title: The price of desertion
docs.text:
Later, Ravenlost found five burned bodies impaled on stakes beside the road.

Matteo identified them as Talon deserters. The bodies were visible evidence of brutality, although the party did not independently investigate who had executed them.

The party traveled for approximately 40 hours through the Mists in total, accumulating exhaustion. Bia carried Matteo during part of the journey.

At sunrise, Ravenlost emerged near the Stone Spine Mountains.

docs.title: The woman in the tower
docs.text:
Ravenlost approached a watchtower approximately 60 feet tall. An elderly woman named Zlava was confined there.

Detail Zlava's account Why she was imprisoned Stealing bread Time in tower Approximately a week and a half Assigned duty Watch for undead hordes and light a warning brazier Supplies Limited and dwindling Status at session end Freed; departed into the Mists alone

docs.title: The undead hordes
docs.text:
Zlava reported that:

  • The hordes began appearing six or seven weeks earlier.
  • Waves sometimes arrived at intervals of roughly two weeks.
  • Different hordes traveled in different directions.
  • The Talons had suffered heavy losses.
  • Some rumors placed a horde's size at 10,000 undead, but that figure was unverified.
  • Survivors burned remains after attacks to prevent the dead from rising again.

Unanswered: Are the hordes moving according to a plan? Who or what could be directing them?

docs.title: Watch order
docs.text:
Watch Events Jain Matteo woke briefly Cadric No specific incident established in the available summary Elisandra Zlava noticed movement in the trees; Elisandra communicated with her telepathically Bia Bia talked with Matteo about the party, her family, and Falkovnia

During Elisandra's watch, Zlava noticed movement in the trees. Roughly 40 minutes later, she indicated the area was clear. No creature was identified and no fight occurred.

docs.title: Bia's conversation with Matteo
docs.text:
• Cadric: Bia described him as a good person, a talented entertainer, and brave when needed. Matteo thought Cadric was “a lot.”
  • Tobin and Mira: Bia explained that her adoptive family remained in Falkovnia when she left.
  • Lekar: Matteo suggested survivors might have fled there, but had no direct information about Bia's family.
  • Undead attacks: Matteo discussed the scale of the invasion and the burning of remains afterward.
  • Midnight wisps: Bia asked whether Matteo had seen strange wisps around midnight. He had not.

Important distinction: Matteo offered Bia a possible destination for her search, not confirmation that Tobin and Mira were safe.

docs.title: Reaching level 5
docs.text:
After a long rest, Ravenlost recovered from one level of exhaustion and reached level 5.

Bia's attribute Level 5 Maximum hit points 73 HP Proficiency bonus +3 Walking speed 40 feet Extra Attack Two attacks when taking the Attack action

Reminder: Extra Attack is part of the Attack action, not an additional bonus action.

docs.title: Freeing Zlava
docs.text:
Ravenlost decided not to leave Zlava imprisoned for stealing bread.

  • The party used rope to reach the upper part of the tower.
  • Bia climbed up and helped free Zlava.
  • Zlava gathered the belongings and supplies she could carry.
  • The party recovered its rope.

Zlava offered two warnings:

“Don't fight. Run.”

“Don't trust the commander.”

Confirmed: Zlava warned Ravenlost against trusting Commander Korath.

Unanswered: What experiences or information lay behind that warning?

Zlava left alone into the Mists. Matteo stayed with Ravenlost.

docs.title: The road to Delmunster
docs.text:
Location What Ravenlost learned Delmunster Closest settlement; approximately 12 hours away Forest of Strangers Route to Delmunster Lekar / Red Gate Refugee destination; approximately four to five days away Stone Spine Mountains Region where Ravenlost emerged from the Mists

Zlava said the Forest of Strangers had been relatively untouched when she last traveled through it, about a week earlier. This was a report, not a guarantee of safety.

End of Session 11: Ravenlost headed toward Delmunster with Matteo. Zlava went her own way.

docs.title: Commander Korath — facts, reports, and suspicions
docs.text: Event or source What Bia knows or has heard Status Childhood village attack Bia heard the name Korath; her father Voros died and her mother Anthea disappeared Bia's memory of the attack Later farm attack Bia heard Korath again, but cannot remember the fight itself Bia's memory and missing memory Ala'kir Identified Commander Korath as a military leader defending a Falkovnian stronghold Reported by Ala'kir Matteo Described Korath's harsh rule and the Talons' conscription practices Reported by Matteo Five impaled bodies Matteo identified them as Talon deserters Bodies witnessed; identification reported Zlava Warned Ravenlost not to trust the commander Warning heard directly

docs.title: What is established
docs.text:
• Commander Korath is female.
  • Bia has encountered the name Korath in three distinct periods of her life.
  • Matteo and Zlava gave the party reasons to be wary of Korath's rule.

docs.title: What remains a theory
docs.text:
• The commander might be the same Korath whose name Bia heard during her childhood and the farm attack.
  • Korath might know something about Anthea's disappearance or Bia's missing memories.

No connection between the commander and either earlier attack has been proven.

Next: Reach Delmunster, keep Matteo safe, and seek news of refugees who may know what happened to Tobin and Mira. Bia must also decide how to approach Commander Korath without mistaking suspicion for proof.

Ravenlost suspects he was her father, but this is unconfirmed. Dr. Goth Human / doctor Mordenshire Sanatorium Ravenlost’s nickname for a dark-eyed doctor who helped care for Wendel. Real name unknown. Anne Polk Human, deceased Mordenshire Sanatorium (records / morgue) Sanatorium patient for approximately three years, known locally for difficult behavior and hysteric fits. Identified as the body in the morgue; Caroline’s records mention an “Anne” who died during surgery, but whether these refer to the same event was not established. Gilda Haywood Human / bookseller and researcher Old Books, Mordenshire Researched Osgood Escar for Ravenlost over four days for a 5 sp fee. Found that he was a botanist who bought Welkspring House 73 years ago, traveled the Mists studying plants, and had a close connection to Glim Brightstone. Found no direct Godfroy connection. Osgood Escar Human / botanist and more than a friend to Glim Brightstone Welkspring House, Echo Island Purchased Welkspring House 73 years ago at approximately age 50. Prolonged his life using a tincture distilled from a grafted Golthias blight, but developed a wooden leg and wood-filled eye socket; has a silver mechanical right hand. Asked Ravenlost to destroy the blight in his greenhouse in exchange for information about Glim, with whom he had a romantic relationship. Lent Ravenlost one fragment of Glim's large battery, requested its eventual return, and asked for news of Glim. Agreed to investigate blight and purple hemlock specimens. Jethro Fletcher Human / sailor Seven Seas, Mordenshire Captain of The Fletcher, which brought Ravenlost to Echo Island and Abbey Point. The promised barrel of liquor could not be obtained at the dry abbey. Bia entrusted Gobbo with 15 gp for Fletcher as compensation; delivery is unconfirmed. Gobbo Goblin / sailor Seven Seas, Mordenshire Captain Fletcher's first mate. Accompanied Ravenlost into the forest near Abbey Point, became trapped inside a hollow log while hiding from a giant spider, and was carried to safety by Bia—log and all. Later decapitated an undead ogre. Returned toward the abbey with Ala'kir. Bia gave him 10 gp for himself and 15 gp to deliver to Fletcher. Shauncey Human Southern shore, Echo Island Local man who helped moor The Fletcher during a storm and sheltered Ravenlost. Directed the party toward Ava. Later found hung over at the sailors' lodging; Ravenlost collected cured fish for its next voyage. Ava (former Welkspring groundskeeper) Human Echo Island Former Welkspring House groundskeeper, paid a full year's wages to stay away for her safety. Warned Ravenlost of strange plant-like figures in the forest. After the greenhouse blight was destroyed, Ravenlost told her Osgood believed the forest would be safer and that she could return; she preferred to enjoy her time off. Not Madam Eva. Gustav (Welkspring automaton) Automaton Welkspring House Small automaton with a humanoid upper body and rolling metal-ball base; resembles Cedgewick and cannot climb stairs. Named Gustav. Tried to help Ravenlost by fetching a 25-pound barrel of sugar and needed a description of a lemon. His builder and precise connection to Glim remain unconfirmed. Unknown forest plant creatures Plant-like humanoids Forest near Welkspring House Thorn-shooting and vine-like creatures attacked Ravenlost on the shortcut to the estate. Osgood suspects contamination from the greenhouse blight entered the forest through runoff and may explain their appearance; this connection is not confirmed. Golthias blight (Welkspring greenhouse) Corrupted plant / creature, destroyed Welkspring House greenhouse Osgood grafted a cutting from a previously defeated Golthias blight onto a birch tree. Its sap prolonged his life but caused bodily corruption. The tree grew hostile, attacked Ravenlost with roots and vines, and was destroyed by Elisandra's radiant magic. Its roots appeared to release black and purple particles into the greenhouse water. Animated topiary dog Mechanical topiary Welkspring House grounds Dog-shaped topiary that sprang from its pedestal when Osgood whistled. Its chest opened to reveal mechanical components and a key to the greenhouse. Hemlock grove frogs Unusual amphibians, defeated Hemlock grove downstream of Welkspring House Four frogs fought Ravenlost, including an enormous king frog with white flowers on its head and back and flowers inside its mouth that released pollen. Tongues restrained or swallowed party members, and bites carried poison. Bia and Elisandra were swallowed during the fight. Abbey Point monks Monks / devotees of Ezra Abbey Point abbey Seventeen monks devoted to Ezra, the Lady of the Mists. They have taken vows of silence and communicate by sign language, which Bia understands. They offered the party food, blankets, and shelter. The abbey is dry; no barrel of ale was available. Abbot Katun Monk / abbot Abbey Point abbey Leader of the silent monks. Told Ravenlost that Glim owned the silver mine, Polk was its foreman, Glim had studied Ezra-related symbols, and five travelers from Mordenshire headed to the mine months earlier without returning. Davos Monk Abbey Point abbey Welcomed Ravenlost to the abbey and helped provide food, blankets, and accommodations. Ala'kir Human / Falkovnian soldier Spider webs near Abbey Point Rescued alive from a spider cocoon. Reported that undead hordes invaded Falkovnia about six weeks earlier, Fort Watten had been breached, and Commander Korath defended a stronghold at Lekar. His regiment suffered heavy losses in the Mists. Elisandra treated his infected shoulder; he returned toward the abbey with Gobbo. Klem Ghost / former miner Abandoned silver mine, Abbey Point Trapped in the mine for 58 years, 7 months, and 3 days. Described an attack by canine creatures, Glim bringing a covered object to the vault, later treasure-seekers, and giant spiders. Asked Ravenlost to retrieve and bury his remains outside the mine; request outstanding. Polk Undead / former mine foreman, defeated Lower silver mine, Abbey Point Glim Brightstone's former foreman. Defended the lower mine and vault alongside skeletons, using dynamite against Ravenlost. Defeated during Session 10. Glim's vault automaton Automaton Glim's vault, Abbey Point Activated while Jain kept watch, seized her leg, and threatened the party. Accepted Bia's password "Osgood," released Jain, played Glim's final recorded log, and powered down. Tobin Underfoot Halfling / Bia's adoptive father Bia's backstory Raised Bia in Falkovnia after her childhood village was destroyed. His whereabouts and safety are unknown amid the undead invasion. Mira Bia's adoptive sister Bia's backstory Tobin Underfoot's daughter and Bia's adoptive sister. Still believed to be in Falkovnia; her safety is unknown. Anthea Orc / Bia's mother, missing Bia's backstory Hid six-year-old Bia in a cellar during the attack on their village. Disappeared; her fate remains unknown. Voros Orc / Bia's father, deceased Bia's backstory Killed during the destruction of Bia's childhood village.

docs.title: Places
docs.text:
A quick-reference list of places Ravenlost has visited or heard about.

Place Type Status Notes Black Lantern Inn Inn Visited Where Ravenlost first met. Initially appeared lively, then revealed itself as dusty and abandoned. Glim Brightstone's laboratory Ruined church / alchemical laboratory Visited Ravenlost found Cedgewick and Glim's wax recordings here. Lemordia Domain Heard of Domain ruled by Victor Mordenheim. Mordent Domain Entered / traveling within Domain containing Mordenshire and territory associated with the Godfroys. Dementlieu Domain / metropolis Heard of Parry's destination when Ravenlost met him in the Mists. Crawford Town / village Visited Residents were disappearing in a pattern connected to Crawford Manor. Locust Branch Hospital Hospital Visited Condemned under the Act of Death. Surrounded by ghosts and considered extremely dangerous. Raven's Claw Inn Inn Visited Crawford inn where townspeople met to discuss the disappearances. Larder Supply Store / supplier Visited / known Operated by Ron in Crawford. Supplied Crawford Manor. Echo Island Island Visited / departed Reached aboard Jethro Fletcher’s The Fletcher. Ravenlost stayed with Shauncey, met Ava, visited Welkspring House, fought a corrupted blight in its greenhouse, and collected hemlock downstream in a grove inhabited by dangerous frogs. The party later sailed to Abbey Point. Crawford Manor Manor Visited Home of Sterling and Ladna Crawford. Site of the disappearances and hidden basement passages. Waterford Town Visited Larger settlement north of Crawford. Home of the Globe Inn, Farrow and Thorn, and Waterford family mausoleum. Globe Inn Inn Visited Ravenlost's lodging in Waterford. Renee is the proprietor. Farrow and Thorn Warehouse / business Visited Farrow's business in Waterford. Ravenlost received recovery jobs here. Argent River River Visited Site of the wrecked merchant vessel containing Lady Waterford's portrait. Waterford family mausoleum Mausoleum / crypt Visited Ravenlost met Lord Waterford's ghost and recovered the jeweled cane and Jeremiah's +1 greataxe here. Waterford Manor Former manor Heard of Former Waterford family home. No longer exists. Idlethorp Abandoned town Visited Former home of the DeLawrence Pouchenelle family. Abandoned when Ravenlost arrived. DeLawrence Pouchenelle manor Manor Visited / destroyed Lady Waterford's childhood home. Contained a hidden laboratory and stitched creatures. Jain later burned the manor. Candle Cross Fortified town / hamlet Visited Elisandra's hometown, built among ruins of an old castle beside the Arden River. Candle Cross keep Keep Visited Seat of Vicar Kellan. Contained Elisandra's preserved room, hidden cavern, and Mist-controlling orb. Florence's inn Inn Visited Ravenlost's lodging in Candle Cross. Arden River River Visited / passed Candle Cross is built beside it. Mordenshire City / town Visited / departed Coastal town and harbor in Mordent. Ravenlost investigated murders and the sanatorium, reported findings to Mayor Alice and Captain O’Connell, received rewards, commissioned equipment, and departed by boat for Echo Island. Blackcard Inn Visited Merchant-oriented inn in central Mordenshire. Bia and Cadric stayed here, and Cadric performed in the tavern. Salty Dog Inn Visited Inn near the sanatorium. Jain and Elisandra stayed here under the name "Jainisandra." The Seventh Sea Inn / sailors’ tavern Visited Coastal tavern in Mordenshire where Ravenlost found Jethro Fletcher unconscious at the bar and met Gobbo, his first mate. Earlier notes call it the Seventh Sea. Pyrite's Booty Shop Visited Mordenshire shop where Ravenlost sold much of its accumulated treasure. Hammerbarn's Blacksmith Blacksmith Visited Mordenshire smith where Jain left her shortsword to be silvered and Cadric and Elisandra commissioned their EC Lights. Atim's Arcana Magic shop Visited Mordenshire magic shop where Cadric purchased an Eversmoking Bottle. Van Richten's Herbalist Herbalist / residence Visited Rudolph Van Richten's shop and residence. Contains his research and a basement ritual chamber. Mordenshire garrison Garrison Visited Headquarters of Captain Kilm O'Connell. Ravenlost left its weapons and armor here before infiltrating the sanatorium. Mordenshire Sanatorium Sanatorium Visited / investigation concluded Three-story facility with basement and restricted ICU. Ravenlost uncovered experimental brain surgeries and records, Dr. Caroline died, Dr. Dave was captured, and evidence linked nightwatchman Peter to the murders. Lord Godfroy financed the restricted addition. Glaston Settlement / region Heard of Rumors say druids near Glaston are trying to find a way through the Mists. Abbey Point Coastal location / abbey Visited / departed for mine Ravenlost arrived aboard The Fletcher, visited an abbey of silent monks devoted to Ezra, and traveled through spider-infested forest to Glim Brightstone's abandoned silver mine. The party ended Session 10 resting in the mine vault. House on Griffin Hill Manor / house Visited Lord Godfroy's estate outside Mordenshire. Ravenlost noticed apparently spectral groundskeepers, disturbed earth, and strange sounds and vibrations beneath the manor. Godfroy hired Ravenlost here to investigate three leads connected to Glim Brightstone. Welkspring House Manor / botanical estate Visited / departed Osgood Escar’s estate on Echo Island, with gardens, a vast greenhouse, animal topiaries, and Gustav the automaton. Ravenlost destroyed a corrupted Golthias blight in the greenhouse and learned about Glim's experiments. At night, blue runes were visible on the gates, fences, and greenhouse framework; whether they prevent ghosts from entering has not been tested. Osgood lent the party a battery fragment and requested news of Glim. Cauldron of Tepist Location Heard of Contains fountains associated with resurrection. Godfroy believes they may have inspired part of Glim's apparatus. alkovnia Domain Heard of / Bia's homeland Bia's homeland and location of Mikhail Hatzimvas's hospital. Ala'kir reported that undead hordes began invading about six weeks earlier, soon after Bia left. Her adoptive father Tobin and sister Mira remain unaccounted for. Glim intended to give Hatzimvas his last piece. Griffin Hill Region / landmark Heard of Associated with Mordent and the Godfroys. Godfroy's Manor Manor Heard of Lord and Lady Waterford were traveling toward a gala there when they died. Old Books Bookshop / research Visited Mordenshire bookshop where Gilda Haywood researched Osgood Escar and his relationship with Glim Brightstone. Weathermay Manor Manor / residence Visited Home of Mayor Alice Weathermay. Located outside of Mordenshire. Ravenlost met with the mayor here to retrieve their reward items. The Fletcher Sailing vessel Traveled aboard / docked at Abbey Point Jethro Fletcher's approximately 30-foot, single-masted boat, crewed with Gobbo. Carried Ravenlost from Mordenshire to Echo Island and then Abbey Point. The promised barrel of liquor was unavailable; Bia gave Gobbo 15 gp to deliver to Fletcher, with delivery unconfirmed. Shauncey’s home House / shelter Visited Near the southern dock on Echo Island. Ravenlost sheltered here after the storm. Later returned to the sailors' lodging, found Shauncey hung over, and collected cured fish before sailing north. Ava’s cabin Cabin Visited / revisited Log cabin on Echo Island where Ravenlost met Welkspring's former groundskeeper. On their return, the party told Ava the blight was destroyed and she could return to the estate, but she preferred to enjoy her year of paid time off. Welkspring forest shortcut Forest path Traveled Dangerous route to Welkspring House. Ravenlost fought thorn-shooting and vine-like humanoids before reaching the wrought-iron estate fence. Welkspring greenhouse Greenhouse / botanical collection Visited Vast steel-and-glass greenhouse holding rare plants from across Ravenloft, including a locked Death Garden. Osgood's grafted Golthias blight attacked Ravenlost here; after its defeat, the party found black and purple particles entering the water from its roots. Water drained toward the surrounding woods. Death Garden Locked poisonous-plant collection Visited Restricted area within Welkspring's greenhouse. Jain picked its lock and narrowly avoided a needle trap, then rested on a chaise lounge after being injured in the blight fight. Hemlock grove Marshy grove Visited Downhill from Welkspring House along the greenhouse runoff, toward the coast. White and unusual purple hemlock grew here. Ravenlost fought four dangerous frogs, including an enormous flower-covered king frog, and collected hemlock afterward. Wooded peninsula north of Abbey Point Peninsula / possible hidden vault Heard of / marked on map Not shown on ordinary maps. Osgood visited it with Glim and described a cave with substantial silver deposits, where Glim planned to establish a vault using his "lunar rites." Whether the vault exists or contains anything remains unknown. Abbey Point abbey Abbey / religious community Visited Home to 17 monks devoted to Ezra who observe vows of silence and communicate in sign language. Davos welcomed Ravenlost; Abbot Katun shared information about Glim, the silver mine, and five missing travelers. The abbey had no alcohol, thwarting the promise made to Captain Fletcher. Abbey Point forest Spider-infested forest Traveled / fought Web-covered route from the abbey toward the silver mine. Ravenlost freed an elk, battled a giant spider, rescued Gobbo from a hollow log, and found silk-wrapped victims including Ala'kir, venomous spiderlings, and an undead ogre. Glim Brightstone's silver mine Abandoned mine / silver deposits Visited / current location Mine near Abbey Point, formerly operated by Glim and foreman Polk. Contains abandoned rails, a trapped minecart, an approximately 85-foot elevator descent, Klem's ghost, undead miners, and a hidden vault. Ravenlost ended Session 10 resting in the vault. Glim Brightstone's mine vault Hidden vault / workshop Visited / current location Lower level of the silver mine. Contains damaged automatons, treasure, and a floating dais whose device was missing. An automaton accepted "Osgood" as a password and played Glim's final recording, pointing toward Mikhail Hatzimvas and Kartikoz. Fort Watten Falkovnian fort Heard of from Ala'kir Fort on Falkovnia's southern border reportedly breached during the undead invasion. Lekar Falkovnian stronghold / settlement Heard of from Ala'kir Ala'kir described a stronghold defended by Commander Korath and recommended it as a place to seek shelter. Current conditions unverified. Kartikoz Location / old inn Heard of in Glim's recording Glim said that if his pursuers caught him, "he will take me to Kartikoz at the old inn." The inn, the pursuer, and Glim's fate remain unidentified. Mikhail Hatzimvas's hospital Hospital / Falkovnia Heard of Mikhail treats victims of Falkovnia's undead affliction. Osgood supplied a letter of introduction; Glim intended to deliver his final piece to Mikhail. Ravenlost has not visited.
